link.description: Components are the default Akita pattern. A component type is five structs (Spec, State, Resources, Ports, and Middlewares) plus a Definition, and the system builder builds named instances from it. This section builds the single-component random-walk example from scratch, a few lines at a time, and introduces the type Comp = ticking.Component[Spec, State, Resources, Ports, Middlewares] alias used throughout the codebase.
